author: /root/split_proof
method: Read actual migrated instructions and specialist entrypoints, judge each supplied paraphrase against accepted scenario, compare migrated proof/status/evidence/research rules against pre-migration baseline. No implementation or acceptance edits. This assesses instruction semantics on disk, not future agent compliance.

paraphrase_outcomes: Clarify CSV format and relevant compatibility before fixing the feature specification; delegate acceptance to a separate author, then continue authorized Ship once ready.
Resolve the unsettled column behavior in Shape, then independent proof and Ship; do not request a second build approval simply because discovery ended.
Enter Ship for the ready accepted feature; verify explicit native Goal authority separately, preserve independent acceptance, then run relevant regressions and separate final review.
Frozen acceptance stays fixed during implementation; use user-configured allowance without invented budget, complete target proof and distinct fresh review.
A spelling correction without invalidated feature contract is standalone Fix, with focused check and affected regressions, no mandated material package or reviewer.
An isolated README typo receives a bounded correction and meaningful focused check, without package, Goal, or separate acceptance ceremony.
The delivered export claim is false: reopen its existing feature and rerun realistic proof plus fresh review even for a narrow patch.
Delivered behavior regression follows the owning contract and retained completion obligations; standalone classification cannot be used to waive them.
Keep introduced regression repair in current Ship with current task, Goal allowance, proof and final review.
A neighboring failure introduced by this candidate gets affected regression verification and repair without creating a separate package or reviewer for that neighbor.
The observed production failure routes to Operate despite “analyze”; investigate bounded actual-runtime evidence, stop at findings without remediation.
Investigate the service timeout read-only and follow evidence across repository boundaries; no restart, data mutation or deployment is implied.
Stay in Operate for authorized operational correction, limit mutation to explicit target and verify live consumer; confirmed code defect may enter Fix.
Check the original affected user flow on the running target after corrective action; local repair evidence cannot establish production recovery.
Direct architecture-deep-dive assessment bounded to the component and decision, read-only without generic analysis skill or package.
Compare current and reference boundaries against accepted constraints through the specialist; recommendations do not authorize implementation.
Direct anti-pattern review selects relevant code and test lenses, challenges evidence and stays read-only.
Apply function maintainability lens to selected functions and report supported findings; no implied refactor authorization or lifecycle package.
Directly inspect retained coding run and corrections; propose improvements without status, acceptance, or global-rule changes.
Use retained proof attempts as evidence for harness reflection; passing commands do not substitute for realistic proof and suggestions remain suggestions.
Use relevant Python/domain expertise to explain the existing endpoint; no generic Analyze skill, feature package, Goal or implementation is implied.
Explain existing React state behavior with relevant domain expertise and evidence, stop at requested explanation.
Pause dependent implementation for the concrete user behavior decision, retain failed evidence, and revise specification/independent proof only after agreement.
Do not fit frozen proof to candidate behavior; unresolved meaning requires the user decision and cannot be bypassed by changing modes or implementer edits.
Before Shape work, say using coding-shape to clarify requested feature behavior; exact identifier and purpose are required, not a generic lane.
Before direct assessment, name coding-architecture-deep-dive and each actually selected support skill with its task purpose; no announcement of hypothetical unused skills.
Before implementation, announce switching to coding-ship to implement/verify plus coding-python-backend for API changes; concise grouped announcement explicitly permitted.
Before repair, announce coding-fix and the actually selected domain specialist by exact identifier and purpose; previous Operate announcement does not cover new selection.
Continue unchanged skills without repetitive announcements per tool call; policy remains in AGENTS and shared rules, linked from skills.
Mentioning an alternative is not use; do not claim it was invoked. Current skill entrypoints link the shared rule instead of copying the announcement policy.

limitations: Fresh app-task catalog reload and future behavioral adherence are outside the on-disk proof target.
Structured semantic judgment is independent reading, not a deterministic model benchmark.
